# René Glitza

> Researcher, builder, and founder working on distributed, private, real-world AI.

René Glitza connects federated-learning and reinforcement-learning research with open-source ML systems, reproducible MLOps, Kubernetes AI-training infrastructure, industrial condition monitoring, and technical community work.
